atoms.text: Class 5R went bowling on a school trip. This bar chart shows how many pupils bowled different numbers of strikes.

instruction.text: How many pupils in 5R bowled at least one strike?

atoms.b: More pupils bowled ((zero one two three)) strikes than any other number of strikes.
((Six Seven Eight ++Nine)) pupils bowled zero strikes.
((One Two Three ++Four)) pupils bowled more than one strike.
((One ++Two Three Four)) more pupils bowled two strikes than bowled three.
((One Two Three ++Four)) more pupils bowled one strike than bowled two.
